title: The Beginning
paragraphs: 8 May, Balakrishna Menon is born to Parukutty and Kuttan Menon in Ernakulam.
note: Birth · downward passage · BSAN3.tif: family identification pending.
caption: Archival group portrait

title: Education
paragraphs: Balakrishna Menon completed his undergraduate studies at St. Thomas College in Thrissur and an M.A. in Literature at Lucknow University. He also pursued law while becoming involved in the freedom movement.
note: Education · Chinmaya Archives confirms he completed the M.A.; the older 'nearly an M.A.' wording was inaccurate.

title: The freedom movement
paragraphs: Balan begins to write and distribute leaflets for the freedom movement: a warrant is issued for his arrest, until his capture in 1944.
note: Freedom movement · sideways gallery · documentary image still to be selected.

title: The written word
paragraphs: Begins to work at National Herald, writing articles in support of the Freedom Movement
note: Journalism · sideways gallery · typographic treatment, not a reproduced newspaper.

title: Skeptic. Student. Seeker.
paragraphs: Balan arrives at Rishikesh for an expose of Himalayan monks.
He enters as a skeptic, stays as a student, and leaves as a seeker.
Swami Sivananda grants him sannyasa diksha and the name Swami Chinmayananda, and points him toward Tapovanji Maharaj for the study of the Upanishads.
note: Turning point · downward passage · ESAN93.tif: preserve the complete captioned print.
caption: The captioned archival print
alt: A group beside water above a handwritten caption.

title: Vedanta for the masses
paragraphs: Swami Chinmayananda descends to the plains with the mission of bringing Vedanta to the masses. His first lecture series commences in Pune in December
note: Teaching · diagonal down/right · 1499_YR67.TIF is illustrative, not the 1951 event.

title: A contribution to a memorial
paragraphs: In February 1963, Swami Chinmayananda announced a ₹10,000 donation to the Vivekananda Rock Memorial Committee.
note: Rock Memorial · Vivekananda Kendra's chronology dates the announcement to 3 February 1963.

title: Vishva Hindu Parishad
paragraphs: Swami Chinmayananda takes part in the 1964 meeting that led to the formation of Vishva Hindu Parishad.
note: VHP · downward passage · typography-led; founding photograph still to be selected.

title: Chinmaya International Foundation
paragraphs: Chinmaya International Foundation was registered in Kerala in 1989. It is housed at Adi Sankara Nilayam, the maternal home of Adi Sankara.
note: CIF · Chinmaya Archives dates registration to 25 April 1989; 1993 in the draft was incorrect.
